supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: recommendationservice_diskio z=12487930818160.06; recommendationservice_latency-90 z=13110.44 (65552.2%); recommendationservice_latency-50 z=9408.12 (47040.6%); frontend_latency-90 z=97.82 (2560.3%)
traces for recommendationservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 1.07->2.31ms (2.15x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.26->6.46ms (1.98x), errors 0.0->0.1741

alternatives_rejected.why: frontend_latency-90 deviation (z=97.82) is far smaller than recommendationservice's latency deviations (z=13110/9408). recommendationservice's own span self-time doubled and its inbound calls show new errors (0.0->0.1741), so frontend is a victim, not the source (E1, E2).

Pure network delay would not explain the extreme recommendationservice_diskio deviation (z~1.2e13), which is the strongest signal in the metrics (E1). The 2x self-time increase fits I/O-bound slowdown (E2). No delay-specific evidence has been found, but logs were not checked to rule it out.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the process or workload saturating disk I/O on the recommendationservice pod, for example runaway logging, temp-file writes, or a stress process. If it persists, restart or reschedule the pod onto a healthy node. Check that latency and frontend error rates recover.
